ogTitle: Account-Based Marketing Services for B2B | Myntmore
ogDescription: Stop marketing to everyone. Go all-in on the accounts that actually move revenue.
schemaDescription: Coordinated multi-channel campaigns across email and LinkedIn that engage the entire buying committee at your highest-value target accounts, so your AE isn't the first name they've seen.

steps.title: Target Account Selection
steps.desc: We build a tiered list of your highest-value target accounts, scored against your ICP, deal size, and buying-intent signals. Tier 1 gets the most coordinated attention; Tier 3 stays on a lighter-touch cadence.

steps.title: Multi-Channel Campaign Design
steps.desc: LinkedIn outreach, email sequences, and (where relevant) retargeting are planned around the same account list, timed to reinforce each other instead of running as separate, uncoordinated efforts.

steps.title: Buying Committee Engagement
steps.desc: We identify and message multiple stakeholders per account, not just one contact, so by the time your AE reaches out, several people at the account already recognise your name.

steps.title: Sales Handoff & Reporting
steps.desc: Engagement data (who opened, replied, clicked, or accepted) rolls up into account-level reporting delivered to your team, so your sales team walks into every conversation with full context.

deliverables: Tiered target account list built from your ICP and deal-size criteria
Coordinated LinkedIn + email campaigns run against the same account list
Multi-threaded messaging to reach multiple stakeholders per account
Structured sales handoff so your AEs open with full context
Monthly account tiering review and list refresh

whoFor.title: Enterprise & Complex-Sale Teams
whoFor.desc: Long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders per deal, where reaching one contact isn't enough to move an account forward.

whoFor.title: Finite Target-Account Teams
whoFor.desc: A defined universe of accounts worth going deep on, not a broad-market volume play. Quality of engagement per account matters more than raw contact count.

whoFor.title: RevOps & Marketing Leaders
whoFor.desc: Teams that want sales and marketing coordinated around the same named accounts, instead of running two disconnected motions that never reinforce each other.

notFor: You don't have a definable, finite list of named target accounts.
Your average deal size doesn't justify the cost of deep, account-level personalisation.
You're running a broad-market volume play, not a focused push on specific accounts.

Multiple stakeholders per account see consistent messaging before your AE ever calls
Sales sees exactly who's engaged and why, before the first conversation happens
